services.desc: ​​​​​​Individual tickets for our first show of the season, the classic historic musical 1776 are on sale now! Celebrate America's 250th birthday, Footlighters style! Want to join the club and become a Footlighters season subscriber? Subscribers get first dibs on their choice of seats, never get shut out of a sold out show, and the best bang for your buck! See all 4 shows for only $85, a savings of $15 over single tickets! ​​​​​​​​​ ​Not sure what to give that theater lover in your life? A Footlighters gift certificate for future shows is a great idea! Give the gift of fantastic theater! When you purchase your tickets online, you will receive an email containing a link to print your tickets
